recommendation: Keep this source fix. It completes the current-spec representation intended by FHIR-41195: implementers see quantity answers as valueQuantity elements constrained to SimpleQuantity, and the current build no longer exposes valueSimpleQuantity as an element path.
issue_request: FHIR-41195 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification and requested completion of the Questionnaire SimpleQuantity changes: avoid saying the item-type quantity answer is valueSimpleQuantity, and constrain Questionnaire.item.initial.value[x] and Questionnaire.item.enableWhen.answer[x] quantity answers to SimpleQuantity.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites git master 8e89009a73, which updated source/questionnaire/codesystem-item-type.xml and changed Questionnaire.item.enableWhen.answer[x] and Questionnaire.item.initial.value[x] from Quantity to SimpleQuantity. Earlier related commit 28dd25d341 for FHIR-37468 had already changed QuestionnaireResponse.item.answer.value[x] to SimpleQuantity and introduced the item-type valueSimpleQuantity wording that FHIR-41195 later corrected.
additional_context: Questionnaire and QuestionnaireResponse are active resources in source/fhir.ini, and the item-type ValueSet is actively listed. Later Applied issue FHIR-41549 added QuestionnaireResponse answer search parameters after FHIR-41195 and introduced a path extension of QuestionnaireResponse.item.answer.valueSimpleQuantity. That is the same impossible choice-element name FHIR-41195 said should not appear; the current StructureDefinition uses SimpleQuantity as the constrained type but the choice element path remains valueQuantity. FHIR-41549 is already represented on the combined branch by a separate reconciliation commit, so it was not re-decided here.
reconciliation: Updated source/questionnaireresponse/bundle-QuestionnaireResponse-search-params.xml so QuestionnaireResponse-answer-quantity declares its build path as QuestionnaireResponse.item.answer.valueQuantity instead of QuestionnaireResponse.item.answer.valueSimpleQuantity. The FHIRPath expression over Quantity was left unchanged because SimpleQuantity is the constrained quantity type, not a separate choice element suffix.
source_changes: source/questionnaireresponse/bundle-QuestionnaireResponse-search-params.xml: changed the QuestionnaireResponse-answer-quantity path extension from QuestionnaireResponse.item.answer.valueSimpleQuantity to QuestionnaireResponse.item.answer.valueQuantity.

related_jiras.note: Established the SimpleQuantity/no-comparator direction for Questionnaire quantity answers and changed QuestionnaireResponse before FHIR-41195 completed the remaining Questionnaire locations.
